scientific_integrity: Exact rank-one Gaussian conditioning, algebraic root and sign analysis prove the stated global optimization; an accompanying symbolic/numerical verifier provides reproducibility but no external certification.
scientific_limitations: One fixed-width moving-average Brownian observation, constant independent positive noise variance, full-path integrated squared error. Multiple observations, other covariance kernels and width-dependent noise are not covered; literature equivalence cannot be excluded.
title: A sharp finite-exposure phase boundary for one noisy Brownian trajectory sensor
